records.title: General Anatomy
records.text: B STR 301 General Anatomy (4) NSc Introduces the student to general human anatomy, examining both cellular and gross anatomy. The relationship between structure and function is a central focus of course content. Course overlaps with: BIOL 413. Offered: jointly with NURS 301.
